card.name: Before names of named clinical studies
card.fires_on: The word 'the' (or 'as', '(' , or the end of a study name) just before or inside the name of a named trial or study group, and the word 'principal' before 'investigator'.

modes.label: Before a named study

modes.label: Principal investigator
modes.description: The word 'principal' after a person's name or title, before 'investigator'.

card.writes: It pushes toward 'Principal' and 'Investigators', words used in research-team titles.
card.plain: It notices when a named research study or its lead investigator is about to be mentioned.
